name: TC-FRU-04: no city link shares another city's listing URL
fullName: truck-junction-web-automation:cypress/e2e/ui/Homepage/FindReliableUsedTrucksNearYou.cy.js#Homepage - FindReliableUsedTrucksNearYou [en] TC-FRU-04: no city link shares another city's listing URL
description:
**Test Case ID:** TC-FRU-04
**Title:** No city link shares another city's listing URL
**Language:** en

**Description:**
Confirm the first two city links do not point at each other's used-truck-in URL.

**Expected Result:**
Each city card links only to its own city listing URL.

**Steps:**
1. Open Find Reliable Used Trucks Near You
2. Verify the first city's link does not use the second city's URL, and vice versa
